theses.title: Calibration debt: autonomous physical systems increase the number
theses.body: 1) Calibration debt: autonomous physical systems increase the number of sensors and instruments whose calibration must remain trustworthy over time. Recent robotics research shows calibration drift can become a safety-critical attack surface, while Transcat reported Q1 FY2027 revenue +22% and service revenue +27%.

theses.title: Cross-world casting collision: aerospace, defense and AI power
theses.body: 2) Cross-world casting collision: aerospace, defense and AI power generation are bidding for the same constrained precision-casting capacity. GE Aerospace agreed on Sep. 8 to acquire Consolidated Precision Products for $11.75B specifically to address casting bottlenecks; Doncasters reported Q2 aerospace revenue +47% and industrial gas turbine revenue +42%.

theses.title: Ceramic-core gating layer: Morgan Advanced Materials explicitly
theses.body: 3) Ceramic-core gating layer: Morgan Advanced Materials explicitly says it is expanding ceramic-core capacity for turbine blades as engine complexity rises. H1 2026 Technical Ceramics revenue grew 7.8%; energy demand included industrial gas turbines serving data centers. This is a third-order input beneath the already-visible casting bottleneck.

theses.title: Inspection-memory scarcity: as generic AI defect detection
theses.body: 4) Inspection-memory scarcity: as generic AI defect detection improves, the scarce data may shift toward rare failures, degradation histories and false-positive/false-negative cases. ESAB completed its Eddyfi acquisition in June, adding recurring inspection and monitoring exposure across aerospace, nuclear, energy and infrastructure.

theses.title: Manufacturing-slot option value: long lead times turn future
theses.body: 5) Manufacturing-slot option value: long lead times turn future production slots into economically valuable rights. Current 2026 procurement data still shows multi-quarter to multi-year lead times for switchgear, transformers and large generators, with projects reserving capacity well before site mobilization. New kernel variables: calibration_debt, cross_world_collision_score, qualification_time, design_complexity_multiplier, negative_data_density, failure_history_uniqueness, slot_option_value. Sources include arXiv 2608.28778 and 2601.16638; GE Aerospace/Reuters Sep. 8–9; Doncasters Q2 2026; Morgan Advanced Materials H1 2026; ESAB/Eddyfi; Transcat Q1 FY2027.
